## P16 — Design research: structural profile rollout



## 0. Invariants

- P16 runs only after terminal P1/P2/P3/P6/P9/P10/P13/P14/P15 and the D14 stage-2 audit.
- D92 keeps every post-P15 FQCN byte-stable; this phase changes physical placement and autoload
  metadata, not PHP vocabulary, public signatures, wire identifiers, DDL or behavior.
- A move is admitted only when a named use case touches fewer top-level physical directories
  afterward. Empty forecast folders and one-class cosmetic folders are forbidden.
- Each package move owns its tests and Composer mapping. Cross-package writes are confined to the
  atomic Testing boundary P16.10 and final metadata/qualification P16.12–P16.13.
- Only the root `CHANGELOG.md` records release-visible changes.

## 1. Producer-adjusted profile census

RAG:— current counts are from `@plan/knowledge/research-00-baseline-metrics.json` and a fresh tree scan. Explicit
literal `src/*.php` Files in P4–P15 were unioned with the current tree; globs and possible runtime
discoveries were not guessed.

| Package | Current | Explicit post-producer floor | P16 profile | Result |
|:--|--:|--:|:--|:--|
| api / conditional operations path | 55 | 155 | C | Three bounded context moves, P16.4–P16.6. |
| modules | 88 | 99 | B | Semantic folders exist; root definitions are placed consistently. |
| intl | 67 | 67 | B | Domain subsystems replace layer-first root. |
| tasks | 59 | 59 | B | Planning/task/project/sprint/time subsystems. |
| crm | 56 | 56 | B | Flex consumer remains level 1; physical structure becomes feature-first. |
| notifications | 44 | 44 | B | Inbox/delivery/digest/preferences subsystems. |
| panels | 11 | 11 | A | No move; D93. |

D91 owns the producer-adjusted rule. Actual execution remeasures each package; the explicit API
floor already proves profile C, while an unexpected threshold crossing elsewhere returns to P16.13
as a contract mismatch rather than silently applying another profile.

## 2. Move mechanism and proof

For a stable namespace such as `CoreX\Intl\Contracts\`, Composer may map the prefix to multiple
subsystem directories. Each item:

1. captures sorted `FQCN → file` and public-signature manifests before the move;
2. performs only `git mv` plus path-sensitive `__DIR__`, config/test and Composer updates;
3. adds the narrowest longer PSR-4 mappings; no classmap or manual require;
4. runs strict PSR-4 and duplicate-class checks;
5. proves the FQCN/signature manifests and behavior tests unchanged.

Use-case evidence is recorded as `before directories → after directory` rows in the item receipt.
The package root keeps only its Laravel provider/module and genuinely package-wide entry points.

## 3. `intl` target map (P16.1)

| Target subsystem | Current ownership |
|:--|:--|
| `Locale/{Contracts,Data,Internal,Exceptions}` | LocaleResolver; LocaleInputs/Policy/Resolution; BCP47/default/request scope; InvalidLocale. |
| `Translation/{Contracts,Data,Internal}` | TranslationReader; LocalizedText/TranslationResult; LaravelTranslationReader. |
| `Currency/{Contracts,Data,Internal,Exceptions}` | CurrencyConverter/Metadata, RateImporter/Provider; conversion/rate/currency values; Brick/SQL/mappers; InvalidRate/SnapshotExpired. |
| `Formatting/{Contracts,Data,Internal,Exceptions}` | MoneyFormatter; FormatPolicy/FormattedMoney; PlainMoneyFormatter; UnsupportedFormatting. |
| `Territory/{Contracts,Data,Internal,Exceptions}` | Geography/Dataset/Address contracts; queries, datasets, references and suggestions; current Address/Reference implementations; schema/access/conflict errors. |

`TimeZone/` is not created: no owned class exists. `CurrencyInfo` keeps its P15-approved class name;
P16 is not a naming pass. Example Locale resolution drops from Contracts+Data+Internal+Exceptions
to one physical top-level directory.

## 4. `notifications` target map (P16.2)

| Target subsystem | Current ownership |
|:--|:--|
| `Inbox/{Contracts,Data,Internal,Exceptions}` | NotificationCenter/Policy; notification/context/subject/action/query/reference values; SQL center and access/conflict errors. |
| `Delivery/{Contracts,Data,Internal,Jobs,Commands}` | channel driver and recipient resolver; delivery target/input/claim/outcome/channel; coordinator/store/drivers; deliver/sweep entry points. |

No `Template/` folder is created: `templateKey` is data carried by a notification and no template

subsystems, in which case `Shared/` is allowed only with an explicit two-owner receipt.

## 6. API profile C map (P16.4–P16.6)

The resolved package path is the P15.11 outcome (`packages/api` or `packages/operations`); PHP
namespace stays `CoreX\Api` in both branches.

## 6.1 P16.4 — operation surface

Top-level contexts: `Definition`, `Invocation`, `Authorization`, `Validation`, `Versioning`,
`Idempotency`, `Pagination`, `Errors`, `Http`, `OpenApi`, `Tools`, `Laravel`. Existing and P13
contracts/data/internal implementations are placed by the operation they serve. A class used by
two contexts stays with the context that owns its invariant; no generic `Data` or root `Internal`
bucket remains. GraphQL is absent by D7.

## 6.2 P16.5 — cost and bulk

`Cost/{Contracts,Data,Internal,Laravel}` owns estimates, budgets, reservations and retention.
`Bulk/{Contracts,Data,Internal,Commands,Laravel}` owns operation state, transfer adapter, workers,
result/failure reads and retention. This item follows P16.4 so shared invocation references use
the already moved physical paths without FQCN changes.

## 6.3 P16.6 — webhooks

`Webhooks/{Contracts,Data,Internal,Commands,Laravel}` owns topic catalogue, subscription/delivery
stores, fanout, signing/keyring, URL policy/transport, retry/worker, management/replay and retention.
Secret/config semantics remain exactly those designed in P14.

## 7. `modules` target map (P16.7)

Existing semantic folders remain. Post-P15 root definitions move physically:

| Target | Definitions |
|:--|:--|
| `Definition/` | ModuleDefinition, ModuleManifest, ModuleDependency, ModuleRuntimeContext, ModuleStatus. |
| `Gate/` | ModuleActivationDecision beside activation gate implementation. |
| `Settings/` | DefaultSettingDefinition beside compiled defaults provider. |
| root | ModulesServiceProvider only. |

P7/P8/P11 additions (`Support`, `Laravel`, compiler/freeze/testing contracts) retain their owning
semantic folders. No existing semantic directory is flattened.

## 8. `crm` target map (P16.8)

CRM stays `flex/crm`; this phase does not promote product vocabulary into CoreX. Physical
subsystems are `Company`, `Contact`, `Lead`, `Deal`, `Activity`, `Context`, and `ApiShared` only
where an API helper genuinely spans more than one entity. Each owns its actions/data/events/models
and API operations. Shared source/pipeline/stage types go to the domain that owns their invariant,
not a generic `Models` bucket.

`RecordRules` is decomposed only physically unless behavior-preserving extraction is already
required to place company/contact search normalization; the P7 exception
`E-FLEX-CRM-SEARCH-LANGUAGE` closes by injecting the existing typed CRM option at composition,
not by creating CoreX config. `src/Testing` moves to `tests/Support` under D94.

## 9. Panels verdict (P16.9)

Five official ecosystems were compared in `@plan/knowledge/research-P16-design-rag.json`. The current CoreX package
is a headless descriptor/access catalogue, not a renderer or admin application. D93 keeps name,
namespace, package identity and current compact `Contracts/Data/Internal` profile. The product
change is limited to clarifying README boundaries and a no-move receipt.

## 10. Testing boundary (P16.10)

D33 closes in one atomic integration item because removing core production autoload before
consumers migrate creates a knowingly broken intermediate graph. The item:

- moves core harness/trait to `packages/core/tests/Support` and adds core/root dev mappings;
- moves auth, tasks and CRM bases from `src/Testing` to their own `tests/Support` (tasks/CRM source
  moves are prepared in P16.3/P16.8 and finalized here);
- makes intl, search-intl, tenancy and tasks-workflow Testbench bootstraps package-local;
- updates root tests without relying on dependency `autoload-dev` propagation;
- removes production `CoreX\Testing`, `CoreX\Auth\Testing`, `CoreX\Tasks\Testing` and
  `Flex\Crm\Testing` discovery and the D33 exception.

No runtime class or Composer package is added. Every package test command must work from its own
package root and the root aggregate must also pass.

## 11. Producer-adjusted Profile B and transfer growth map (P16.11)

The post-producer census is authoritative (D107): attributes has at least 44 production classes
before physical profile work and therefore cannot be Profile A. P10.8 owns its physical-compatible
subsystem structure; P16.11 records it as Profile B and proves the B-conformant no-move against
that semantic subsystem/use-case span. It may never select A or delegate an unowned move to
metadata-only P16.12. No-move verification covers auth/access, media, transfer,
search, recurrence, tasks-workflow, wakeup, workflow, panels, search-intl and search-meilisearch.
The import-export tombstone remains excluded by D13. For each package the receipt records count,
profile and why a new top-level directory would not reduce a named use-case span.

`docs/architecture/structure-profiles.md` gains the transfer growth map, not directories:
Definition, Source, Sink, Mapping, Validation, Execution, Checkpoint, Format, Reporting, Laravel.
Promotion happens only after measured growth and a named use case crosses two top-level folders.

## 12. Reconciliation and final proof (P16.12–P16.13)

P16.12 refreshes only path-bearing sources: package Composer autoload, PHPStan paths, graph-gate
allowlists, CI/split paths, docs and root CHANGELOG. `extra.corex.public-api` is asserted unchanged
because D92 keeps namespaces stable. Generated artifacts go through their generators.

P16.13 runs every affected package lane, `composer test:packages`, PG lanes for SQL packages,
root lint/analyse/arch/package graph/naming/public-surface/BC gates, strict optimized autoload and
two negative fixtures: one duplicate FQCN in a secondary PSR-4 directory and one production
`*\Testing` import. Each must fail for its named diagnostic, be removed, and return green.

## 13. Item dependency map

`P16.1`, `P16.2`, `P16.3` are independent after producers. API is sequential
`P16.4 → P16.5 → P16.6`. `P16.7`, `P16.8`, `P16.9` are independent. P16.10 waits P16.3/P16.8;
P16.11 may run after producer phases; P16.12 waits P16.1–P16.11; P16.13 is last.
